value.name: buys weekend groceries
value.description: She stops at the market and buys bread, cheese, and fruit for the weekend while walking home.
evidence: she stopped at the market and bought bread and cheese and fruit for the weekend
walking back along Pine Street with the paper bag against her hip

value.name: reflects on dead father
value.description: She thinks about her father’s death, his small estate, and the unresolved conversations they never had.
evidence: she thought ... about her own father, who had been dead for nine years and whose small estate she had administered herself
and about the conversations she had not had with him before he died

value.name: reflects on estranged brother
value.description: She thinks about the conversations she never had with her brother after their father died.
evidence: and about the conversations she had not had with her brother after

value.name: recognizes work as self-denial
value.description: She realizes that the work she does for others is also the work she has avoided doing for herself.
evidence: and about the way the work she did for other people was also, in a manner she was not always willing to examine, the work she had not been able to do for herself

value.name: recalls intake call about unnamed son
value.description: She remembers the second intake call from Friday afternoon, when a woman could not say her son's name.
evidence: She thought about the woman whose intake call she had taken on Friday afternoon, the second one, who had not been able to say her son's name.

value.name: rejects Lucia's unread letter
value.description: She decides not to read Lucia's letter and treats it as a private fact that need not be examined.
evidence: She thought about Lucia's letter, which she had not read and which she would not read
and which existed now only as a private fact between Lucia and her dead mother
and need not be examined further by anyone

value.name: remembers Rosa ending secrecy
value.description: She thinks about Rosa, who had hidden in the family for thirty-one years and then decided to stop being a secret.
evidence: She thought about Rosa, who had spent thirty-one years being a secret in this family and who had decided last Thursday, in the same dining room, to stop.

value.name: remembers Daniel's decision not to sell house
value.description: She recalls Daniel's emotional confession and his decision to keep his mother's house.
evidence: She thought about Daniel, who had ordered coffee in Italian and apologized for things in chronological order and cried without sound and decided not to sell the house his mother had wanted him not to sell.

value.name: holds boundaries and questions attachments
value.description: She reflects that she has maintained her boundaries and is still undecided about her attachments.
evidence: She thought about her own boundaries, which she had held, and about her own attachments, which she had not yet decided what to
